statement_summary: Written information security program (POL-01 with P01, P02, P08)
Owner-adviser designated Qualified Individual in writing
Annual risk assessment and after material changes, using SP 800-30
Risk decision rules; High risks never accepted as they are
Annual control test with outside review every second year
Annual policy review and after changes or incidents
Security log of setting changes and new tools
Sanctions for any future employee or contractor
Written, time-limited exceptions; Qualified Individual approval for MFA or encryption exceptions
No customer information to a provider without contractual safeguards
Pre-adoption security check for any new tool
Vendor list and annual vendor review, including SOC reports and customer controls
Owner-started, watched remote support; unattended access off
Provider contracts require prompt security event notice
Unique accounts; no shared credentials
MFA on every service that holds customer information or moves money
Unique 14-character passphrases in a password manager
Business devices for business use only
Callback to the number on file before any money movement or contact change
Sealed emergency access codes; hardware key as second MFA method
Monthly review of sign-ins, forwarding rules, connected apps, and beneficiaries
Three-level data classification
Restricted data only in approved systems; never in consumer AI tools
Full-disk encryption on every device and drive
Secure links instead of email attachments
Encrypted cloud backup with 1-year retention; encrypted USB copy in the safe
Books and records kept as Florida requires, with a records index
Shredding; device wipe or certified destruction with a record
Delete former-client data after two years unless required; annual January review
Business network or phone hotspot only
Automatic updates and antivirus stay on
AI tools only after assessment, business terms, and approval; figures checked; all-party recording consent
Annual training covering business email compromise; monthly reminders
Incident runbook with printed contacts
Same-day incident log with discovery date and time
Custodian fraud line called first for a suspected fraudulent payment
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
No ransom without counsel and an OFAC check
Successor adviser arrangement for owner incapacity
